title: Stack push and pop
brief: Implement a stack using a list. Write run_stack(ops) where ops is a list of operations: ["push", x] pushes x, ["pop"] removes the top item. Return a list of the values popped, in order; a pop on an empty stack contributes None instead of crashing.
markpoints: Push adds to the top of the stack
Pop removes and returns the most recently pushed item (LIFO)
Handles popping an empty stack without an error
